title: Faithful natural evaluation of degree-zero object cohomology
statement: Let C be a small category, T a Grothendieck topology admitting abelian sheafification, and suppose HasExt for its abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For an abelian sheaf A and X in C, evaluate a class in Ext^0 of the sheafified free abelian representable at X to A by applying its Ext-Hom image to the sheafification of the identity generator. This evaluation is injective, sends zero to zero, and commutes with every sheaf morphism A → B and the degree-zero cohomology map induced by it.

source.place: H', Ext.addEquiv₀, sheafificationAdjunction, AddCommGrpCat.adj.whiskerRight and yonedaEquiv

proof.text: Compose the injective Ext-Hom equivalence, sheafification adjunction, free-forgetful adjunction on presheaves and Yoneda equivalence. The composite evaluates on the sheafified identity generator.

The additive Ext-Hom equivalence sends zero to the zero sheaf morphism, whose evaluation is zero. Naturality follows by applying injectivity of Ext.mk₀ to its postcomposition formula, and then evaluating the composite sheaf morphism.
